Body.Content: Azure Search is a search-as-a-service solution that allows developers to incorporate search capabilities into their applications without having to worry about the complexities of full-text search or to deploy, maintain or manage any infrastructure. Even as non-experts, developers can construct rich ranking models that connect search results to application or business objectives. For more information, see Azure Search overview. For a comprehensive look at pricing, see Azure Search Pricing Details.

Azure Search is a search-as-a-service solution that allows developers to incorporate search capabilities into their applications without having to worry about the complexities of full-text search or to deploy, maintain or manage any infrastructure. For more information, see Azure Search overview . For a comprehensive look at pricing, see Azure Search Pricing Details .
